Discover 10 of the largest healthcare stocks to watch by market capitalisation. ## How to trade or invest in healthcare stocks. There are two ways that you can get exposure to healthcare stocks: investing and trading. When you invest in healthcare stocks, you’ll be buying shares in a company or a healthcare exchange traded fund (ETF) outright. You can trade on healthcare stocks via derivative products, such as spread bets and CFDs. Both products are leveraged, so you’d need to put down a small initial deposit to gain full market exposure.
